dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Why, hello there! Thanks for your concern!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: As you can see, I'm having a hard time with these Linebreakers, these fighters who dwell underwater. I haven't really had much success yet.

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: But so long as I keep my head down and keep at it, believe me, I shall eventually earn my victory!
